features.name: Project discovery and JMAP proof of concept
features.description: Confirm repository state, current documentation, secure Stalwart connectivity, session discovery, required capabilities, and read-only mailbox metadata.

features.name: Secure authentication
features.description: Authenticate existing Stalwart users and provide secure, isolated application sessions.

features.name: Inbox and mailbox listing
features.description: Show the authenticated user's real mailbox and messages with pagination, refresh, and clear states.

features.name: Safe email reading
features.description: Display plain-text and safely isolated HTML email, metadata, read state, and attachment metadata.

features.name: Compose and send
features.description: Implement the first end-to-end send workflow through JMAP and Stalwart without adding an SMTP client.

features.name: Essential mailbox actions
features.description: Add reply, forward, read state, star, move, archive, trash, search, threading, and drafts as accepted.

features.name: Attachments and UX refinement
features.description: Add secure attachment handling, keyboard support, responsive layouts, accessibility, and UX refinements.

features.name: Limited offline storage and synchronization
features.description: Optional bounded mail caching and JMAP state synchronization after online flows are stable.

features.name: Notifications and real-time updates
features.description: Optional polling, JMAP event updates, browser notifications, and background push only when justified.
